description: Malmö stad: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Malmö stad. Coverage: Malmö stad. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Solcellsanläggningar ägda av Malmö stad, elproduktion (kWh); Laddstationer för elfordon; Solcellsanläggningar totalt kommunen, antal; Solcellsanläggningar totalt kommunen, installerad effekt (MW). Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
